key_provisions_or_claims: Extends physical invasion of privacy liability to entering the airspace above another's land without permission to capture images or recordings.
Liability for up to three times general and special damages, plus punitive damages.
Civil fines of $5,000 to $50,000, with disgorgement of proceeds for commercial purposes.
Constructive invasion of privacy covers capture via any device without physical trespass.
Exemptions for lawful law enforcement and government investigative activity.
annotation.summary_en: California bill chaptered October 2015 amending Civil Code section 1708.8 to extend physical invasion of privacy liability to knowingly entering the airspace above another's land without permission to capture images or recordings, a provision aimed at drones. It sets treble damages, punitive damages and civil fines.
annotation.title_clean: California Civil Code Section 1708.8 amendment – Invasion of privacy (airspace trespass)
